title: Understanding Variance
text: Variance refers to how much the predictions of a model vary for different datasets. If you remove a feature, think about how it might affect the model's ability to capture the variability in the data.

title: Role of the 'veg' Column
text: The 'veg' column represents the pounds of vegetables bought. Consider how removing this column might affect the model's ability to predict the total bill accurately.
